title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: SEC. 1. This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act.

status.provenance: Approved by Governor September 30, 2024. Filed with Secretary of State September 30, 2024.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

who.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

action.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

products.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

exceptions.provenance: No exceptions are mentioned for the regulated PFAS in menstrual products.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The text does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'.

intentionally_added.provenance: Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product.

type.provenance: The department shall publish on its internet website, on or before January 1, 2027, a list of accepted testing methods for testing for regulated PFAS in menstrual products.

who.provenance: The department shall publish the list for informational purposes.

action.provenance: The department shall publish on its internet website, on or before January 1, 2027, a list of accepted testing methods...

products.provenance: The list is for testing methods for regulated PFAS in menstrual products.

exceptions.provenance: No exceptions are mentioned in this regulation.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The text does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'.

intentionally_added.provenance: This regulation pertains to testing methods, not intentional addition.

type.provenance: A manufacturer of a menstrual product shall register with the department and provide specified information and a registration fee.

who.provenance: A manufacturer of a menstrual product, as defined in this article, shall register...

action.provenance: A manufacturer shall register with the department and provide specified information and a registration fee.

products.provenance: The registration is required for menstrual products.

exceptions.provenance: No exceptions are mentioned for the registration requirement.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The text does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'.

intentionally_added.provenance: The registration requirement pertains to products with intentionally added substances.
